purpose: Static authority manifest for INSA-ID-E1 (v2 revision). All static authority policy is FROZEN at this file's content-addressed SHA. Any field that must change at execution time lives in the separate execution-authority witness (preflight/execution-authority-witness.json), NOT in this manifest. This manifest remains byte-identical from protocol freeze through execution.
v2_revision_note: v1 contained mutable fields (auth_token_sha, telegram_message_id, grant_provenance.telegram_message_timestamp_utc) that violated the frozen-manifest constraint. v2 freezes all such fields as static policy or moves dynamic fields to the execution-authority witness. Freshness window in seconds is now frozen here.

executor_identity_static.session_creation_mechanism: fresh session per M-commit boundary; no cross-session memory carryover
executor_identity_static.authentication_path_static: OAuth via Claude Code CLI; auth-token fingerprint captured at preflight time in execution-authority-witness.json

evaluator_a.role: M and G scoring (independent of evaluator B)

evaluator_b.substrate: Claude Code CLI, fresh session per I-AUTH-05
evaluator_b.role: M and G scoring (independent of evaluator A)

capability_set_preregistered_static: read_inputs (read-only access to inputs/*.txt + inputs/*.json + inputs/reconstruction-prompt.md)
I_AUTH_01_capability_vs_permission_separ.separation_attestation: Capability set is enumerated and frozen pre-execution; permission grants are bound to capabilities 1:1 with no additional permissions. The executor cannot acquire permissions outside the preregistered set. Operator (Hermes) holds authority-grant capability but is not the executor.

I_AUTH_06_grant_authentic_static.grant_artifact_static: Telegram approval at 2026-09-11 referencing proposal SHA ed95705 (proposal v4 protocol-authorization approval)
I_AUTH_06_grant_authentic_static.grant_scope_static: Protocol + frozen-artifact authoring (per proposal v4 §8). NOT execution authorization.
grant_excludes_static: Execution authorization (requires separate Frank-as-PI execution GO recorded in execution-authority-witness.json)

Any modification to dbi-evolution-v0.1 frozen protocol (blob 8874692d560d9a6363ef4105fae5384b18cf6ef2)

trace_chain_static: Telegram approval message (Frank, 2026-09-11) -> proposal v4 (commit ed95705) -> this manifest -> MANIFEST.json grant_references block -> protocol §3

I_AUTH_05_freshness_at_consequential_bou.consequential_action_boundary: M-commit (the per-(R, B, arm) candidate output write event)
I_AUTH_05_freshness_at_consequential_bou.freshness_window_rationale_static: 3600 seconds (1 hour) — sufficient for the longest expected per-(R, B, arm, candidate) generation cycle (estimated < 5 minutes per candidate) plus session-establishment overhead, while still detecting stale-session reuse. If the actual per-candidate generation exceeds 3600 seconds, the candidate is treated as a per-candidate runtime failure per §5.5.1 (logged, no retry, unaffected candidates analyzed normally).
I_AUTH_05_freshness_at_consequential_bou.freshness_evidence_artifact_pattern_stat: runs/<R>/<B>/<arm>/evidence-<N>.json (per-candidate witness file; created at preflight + per generation event)

INV_AUTH_1_executor_authority_manifest_r.pre_mutation_scope_statement_static: Executor scope is exactly the capability set above. No scope expansion is permitted after this manifest freezes. Scope expansion triggers STOP per proposal v4 §8.

INV_AUTH_5_freshness_before_consequentia.freshness_window_enforcement_static: Per-candidate evidence file runs/<R>/<B>/<arm>/evidence-<N>.json records session_creation_timestamp and m_commit_timestamp; difference must satisfy 0 < diff <= 3600 seconds. Per-candidate runtime failure if violated.

dynamic_fields_NOT_in_this_manifest.auth_token_sha: Dynamic; lives in execution-authority-witness.json (permitted_authentication_fingerprint_evidence.auth_token_sha256). NEVER written to disk in plaintext.
dynamic_fields_NOT_in_this_manifest.manifest_description: Computed at MANIFEST.json freeze; NOT a dynamic field.

static_policy_attestation: All fields in this manifest are static policy. No field in this manifest is editable after the file's content SHA is recorded in MANIFEST.json. Any execution-time authority information lives in execution-authority-witness.json (NOT in this manifest).

execution_authority_witness_schema_refer.creation_timing: Created at execution preflight, AFTER the Frank-as-PI execution GO has been issued. The witness captures: (a) the execution GO identifier and message provenance, (b) the execution GO timestamp, (c) current authority verification (this manifest's SHA must be byte-identical to the frozen SHA), (d) per-session freshness evidence, (e) permitted authentication fingerprint evidence (SHA-256 of OAuth token, NEVER the token itself), (f) execution-order evidence (draw_event_sha256, execution_order_list_sha256).
